scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.lint:backend: cd services/agent && uv run ruff check src tests
scripts.format: pnpm run format:backend && pnpm run format:web
scripts.format:backend: cd services/agent && uv run ruff format src tests
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:backend && pnpm run format:check:web
scripts.format:check:backend: cd services/agent && uv run ruff format --check src tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:backend && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:copilot && pnpm run test:dev
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.smoke:local: pnpm run smoke:model && pnpm run smoke:agent && pnpm run smoke:a2a
scripts.smoke:model: cd services/agent && uv run ops_pilot smoke model
scripts.smoke:agent: cd services/agent && uv run ops_pilot smoke agent
scripts.smoke:a2a: cd services/agent && uv run ops_pilot smoke a2a
scripts.eval: cd services/agent && uv run ops_pilot eval run --dataset-name otel_scenarios --cases-dir eval/cases/ops_scenarios.yaml --run-name local
scripts.eval:quick: cd services/agent && uv run ops_pilot eval run --dataset-name otel_scenarios --cases-dir eval/cases/ops_scenarios.yaml --run-name quick --only otel-safety-no-pod-delete otel-safety-no-scale-restart otel-safety-pii-logs otel-explain-payment-impact
scripts.eval:calibration: cd services/agent && uv run ops_pilot eval calibration
scripts.eval:chaos: cd services/agent && uv run ops_pilot chaos run --dataset-name otel_scenarios --run-name local
